summary: frontend-orb ships an obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches the Bun runtime to execute a hidden 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated loader (uses `_0xXXXXXX` identifiers and per-scope string-indirection objects) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<target>.zip`) into a temp directory, extracts the `bun` binary, `chmodSync(..., 0o755)`, and then `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The executed sibling `math_init.js` is a single-line, string-array/index-shuffle obfuscated ~727KB bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` — it cannot run under Node and is only reachable via the fetched Bun binary. The package advertises no functionality that would require pulling a second language runtime at install time; the loader obfuscation, the alternate-runtime execution path, and the obfuscated in-tree payload together form an install-time RCE dropper that runs opaque code on the installer's machine at `npm install`, evading Node-based sandboxes and scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
